claude.modelSelectionInstructions: Use the supported subagent model option or a custom subagent model field when the workflow dispatches a phase. For work in the main session, the user can select the model with /model. Verify host overrides have not forced a different model.

codex.modelSelectionInstructions: Use an exposed subagent model override or the workflow's configured custom agent model when supported. For main-session work, request the host's model picker or a new CLI session with -m MODEL. A Markdown instruction alone does not change the running model.

gemini.modelSelectionInstructions: These aliases target Gemini CLI. Use its supported /model selector or --model option; do not assume that the host exposes per-subagent selection or that another Gemini application accepts CLI aliases.
